## Standing operator rules
- Any new secret reference in `config/secrets.yaml` must use `vault://ledgerly/<ENV>/<KEY>` and never an environment-variable placeholder.
- Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.
- Run “Webhook v1 to v2 cutover” between other work; execute its eight supplied steps in order, one at a time.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix double-counted refunds in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`. Tenacity refactor is stopped until next sprint. Webhook cutover step 5 is complete.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Sandbox: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`. `https://sbx-pay-a.ledgerly.dev` is superseded. Snapshot: `webhook_cutover_20250308`; cursor: `primary`; date: `20250308`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Five-attempt retry decorator around webhook handlers: caused duplicate customer emails.

## Recent work
Completed cutover steps 3–5. Consolidated CLI billing filters, fixed `dest="currency"`, removed duplicate `--currency`, and passed 37 CLI/command tests. Worker suite passed 118 tests. `ruff check ledgerly/cli.py tests/test_cli.py` found E501 at lines 117 and 203.
